title: Potential Hessian Ascent IV: Sampling the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model at $β< 1$
summary: We give a polynomial-time algorithm to sample from the Gibbs measure of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model with $o_n(1)$ error in total-variation distance (TVD) at any inverse-temperature $β< 1$. The algorithm combines algorithmic stochastic localization (ASL) with rejection sampling over path-space via Jarzynski's equality (JE). The analysis extends the authors' prior $β< 1/2$ result [arXiv:2605.03718] by replacing all global regularity requirements in the stochastic differential equation (SDE) error analysis with local regularity around likely trajectories.
